steps.female_content: Bianca stealthily drags a woman in a suspicious gray coat into the studio.

steps.content:
Hmm hmm, hmm hmm hmm? 
(Just to confirm this again. You do remember our plan, right?)
Bianca covers the person's mouth nervously, afraid that even his voice might give the plan away and leave behind clues. She nods assertively.
steps.female_content: Bianca covers the person's mouth nervously, afraid that even her voice might give the plan away and leave behind clues. She nods assertively.

steps.content: Her accomplice is clearly unconvinced. Surreptitiously, Bianca writes two words in his palm: Don't worry.
steps.female_content: Her accomplice is clearly unconvinced. Surreptitiously, Bianca writes two words in her palm: Don't worry.

steps.content:
Hmm hmm hmm... 
(You can speak, you know...)
Actually, he really doesn't need to worry, because Bianca will never forget the first time they discussed the "plan".
steps.female_content: Actually, she really doesn't need to worry, because Bianca will never forget the first time they discussed the "plan".

steps.content: One day ago

Under the clear sky, they face each other alone on an empty street, their hearts still pounding from the recent encounter with the Corruptor. The journalist who almost left in a huff now gazes admiringly at Ashy, the man who dared to put himself back on the stake on Gray Mirror.
steps.female_content: Under the clear sky, they face each other alone on an empty street, their hearts still pounding from the recent encounter with the Corruptor. The journalist who almost left in a huff now gazes admiringly at Ashy, the woman who dared to put herself back on the stake on Gray Mirror.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your journalism sense will indeed be an invaluable aid. Let's help each other out, then?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Haha, I knew it. No matter how much I try to hide it, the brilliance of my intelligence will still shine through. Tell me, what do you want from the great genius Bianca?

Don't be fooled by her cool attitude, she's already set off the celebratory fireworks inwardly. How brave, determined, and resourceful is Ashy! Her ponytail, wagging like a tail, already exposes her excitement.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The disappearances are likely linked to the votes on Gray Mirror and the effects of the new Mania. To uncover the truth and retrieve the missing citizens, I need to find whoever is behind this app... be it the creator or the admin. But I lack the information or tools to achieve that.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Anything Mania-related is my expertise, but as for the environment that might nurture this new type of Mania: Gray Mirror, its users, and the dark web... I must admit my ignorance about them.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Uh-huh!

Amazing. Bianca doesn't understand a word, but decides to pretend she does anyway. As a journalist, it's only natural she must keep her interviewee talking and extract as much information as possible!

Ashy goes on about some more incomprehensible things like the M-value monitoring network failing, recalling the samples, and some kind of elusive and untraceable presence. But luck is always on Bianca's side. She didn't miss the most crucial part about the collaboration!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The Gray Mirror votes aren't just a simple battle of good versus evil. The posts are also competing against each other. A person can't possibly read all the posts even if they're online 24/7. The posts vie for the limited attention of all Gray Mirror users. In other words, they're competing for popularity and traffic.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I need the Exterminator's post to gain more traction on Gray Mirror so that it can lure out the strongest and most stable form of the new Corruptor. That way, I can analyze it properly and trace the culprit. And more importantly...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I want to steer this popularity and malice away from ordinary citizens. Do you understand what I mean?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: So, you're saying you need a major scoop! You wanna become the top voting post, so that everyone on Gray Mirror will be talking about you! I see...

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: To manipulate the trend, you must become the trend itself!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's correct, only... my duties and my department are quite special. Appearing publicly could cause problems, so we must proceed with caution.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm counting on you, expert!
[Exit flashback][Studio]
He calls her expert! Surely there's no more flattering title in the world. To prove she's worth this title, Bianca will give it her best shot!
steps.female_content: She calls her expert! Surely there's no more flattering title in the world. To prove she's worth this title, Bianca will give it her best shot!

steps.content: Makeup, ready. Script, ready. Teleprompter, ready. Interview guest (that is, that pile of gray fabric over there), ready too! She's put in a lot of effort to make sure it aligns with the description of the Exterminator on Gray Mirror. Bianca nods to the director, and the special news program finally goes live.
[News broadcast intro (pretend there is one)]

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Hello, everyone. This is Bianca, and welcome to Firsthand News!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: The Eastside disappearance cases have been the talk of the town on the internet. At first, netizens identified the wrong perpetrator, and now it seems that Gray Mirror itself has been the culprit. Everyone seems to have their own theory.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Currently, most believe that the Gray Mirror app directly caused the disappearances.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: And just now, our reporters received reliable information that may give this case yet another unexpected twist.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Let's hear from none other than the Exterminator!
The director switches the camera to a man in a strange gray coat and mask. His mysterious demeanor causes a stir both online and offline.
steps.female_content: The director switches the camera to a woman in a strange gray coat and mask. Her mysterious demeanor causes a stir both online and offline.

steps.content:
<color=#b0e7b4>Exterminator's Vote Ratio:
30% Inferior | 70% Perfect</color>

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Nice to meet you, Exterminator. This is DisTV. The vote regarding you on Gray Mirror has recently attracted a lot of attention. It appears that you've cleared the suspicion that you were the perpetrator of the disappearances. Regarding your subsequent decision to go against Gray Mirror, do you have anything to clarify here in front of the public?

Hello everyone, I am the Exterminator who was once maligned by Gray Mirror. I have proven my innocence, and also exposed the injustice hidden within Gray Mirror: They are trying to erase an innocent citizen through violent means.
That is why I will crack Gray Mirror and seek to completely shut down this illegal app.

<color=#b0e7b4>Exterminator's Vote Ratio:
33% Inferior | 67% Perfect</color>

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: But as far as I know, Gray Mirror has indeed punished many hidden evil acts, and a small portion of users have even driven social progress with their discourse. What do you think about these positive effects?

I've only known about Gray Mirror for less than two days. Without a thorough understanding, I don't think I'm entitled to judge it. But I believe every citizen has the right to know the true nature of Gray Mirror to avoid being exploited by it.

Just because they can vote with a tap doesn't mean they have the right to judge, punish, or even harm others. This process is devoid of the slightest bit of legitimacy and justice, as proven by the disappearance cases. Have they not caused more harm than the so-called progress to our society?

While listing Gray Mirror's crimes, you omit the real threat it's brought about: Mania. For the public, this truth is irrelevant, as the Gray Mirror votes now already have little to do with justice or the truth.

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: Where did this Exterminator come from? Is this person calling us ignorant?

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: I think he's just mad because he found himself in a vote.
steps.female_content: I think she's just mad because she found herself in a vote.

steps.content: On the busy Fifth Avenue, many have tapped open the real-time news and stopped to share the link. The speech in that altered voice can be heard in every corner of the district.

<color=#b0e7b4>Exterminator's Vote Ratio:
45% Inferior | 55% Perfect</color>

The emergence of free, unregulated power is a sign that we as a society are going backward. Admit it, Gray Mirror doesn't bring justice. The power, recognition, and protection it provides all serve to unleash the malice in people's hearts, so that they can embrace degradation fearlessly!

I will face my enemy openly on this battlefield and bear the responsibility and consequences of my choices. Those of you hiding in anonymity and purging others with your taps and votes on Gray Mirror, can you do the same?
In the Bureau's recreation room, Hecate and Nightingale stay in front of the TV watching the live interview, unusually for them.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Thank you for sharing your thoughts. But even at this moment, we're seeing an influx of new users on Gray Mirror, and new votes still keep popping up. Do you really think you can fight against all of them?
Gray Mirror has no right to judge anyone. This so-called elimination by voting is no fair trial, it's murder! This abhorrent crime must be stopped, and I am here to do just that.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The voice in the news, though it's altered, it sounds very familiar. Is it Chief?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Yes, Chief said this was a necessary sacrifice to uncover the mastermind.

<color=#b0e7b4>Exterminator's Vote Ratio:
56% Inferior | 44% Perfect</color>
[Back to the studio]

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: That's quite a radical response. But you're still on the Gray Mirror's voting list. Aren't you worried?

<color=#b0e7b4>Exterminator's Vote Ratio:
71% Inferior | 29% Perfect</color>
The interview proceeds exactly as you and Bianca scripted, reaching its final line. The number of viewers online hits a peak. You've nearly attracted all the attention related to Gray Mirror.

Under the either disdainful or curious anticipation of everyone, you place your phone on the podium, open Gray Mirror, and swipe to the Exterminator's vote you saved earlier. You point it at the camera, and then look directly into the lens.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: As the Exterminator, I'm declaring war on Gray Mirror and everyone behind it.

As soon as the words leave your mouth, the phone in front of you vibrates violently, and the Gray Mirror voting screen glitches. Tentacles burst out of the screen, overturning the camera in front. A powerful monster appears at the perfect moment, ending the show.

Bianca has already evacuated everyone else in the studio. You too shed the Exterminator's disguise to face the execution head-on. The digitalized Mania is coming for you, and you've been waiting for this moment...

<color=#dc143c>Exterminator's Vote Ratio:
90% Inferior | 10% Perfect</color>
